common.tagline: Not home. Not work. Somewhere in between.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Welcome
login.intro: Log in with your email. We'll send you a 6-digit code to type in here. No password needed.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It can take a minute, so check your spam folder too.
login.badCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
login.rateLimited: Too many login emails right now. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

needInvite.title: Third Place Berlin is invite-only
needInvite.body: Ask a member to send you an invite link. If you have a link or code, paste it here.

join.title: You're invited!
join.body: Tell us your name and you're in.
join.name: Your name
join.invalid: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask your friend for a new one.

waiting.title: Almost there!
waiting.body: Members vouch for each new person. You have {{vouches}} of {{required}} vouches.
waiting.tip: Meanwhile, complete your profile so members can get to know you.

removed.title: Your access has ended
removed.body: An admin removed your account from Third Place Berlin. If you think this is a mistake, contact the organisers.

welcome.title: Welcome to Third Place Berlin
welcome.name: Name
welcome.skillsHint: Up to 10 each, e.g. Excel, salary negotiation, German bureaucracy
welcome.circlesHint: You can join more circles later.
welcome.privacy: I agree to the privacy notice: my profile is visible only to logged-in members, my email is never shown, and I can download or delete my data at any time.

circles.title: Circles
circles.intro: Join the ones you care about. Each has its own meetups, chat and board.
circles.legend: 🔓 Open: join instantly · 🔒 Closed: a member recommends you, then a host approves
circles.proposeBody: Send an idea to the admins. They approve it before it appears.
circles.closedInfo: This circle is closed. A member recommends you, then a host approves your request.
circles.membersOnly: Meetups, chat and members are visible after you join.
circles.needsRecommendation: A member needs to recommend this person first.
circles.notFound: This circle doesn't exist or isn't available.

propose.title: Propose a new circle
propose.intro: The admins review every proposal so circles stay meaningful.
propose.name: Name
propose.sent: Thanks! The admins will review your proposal.

home.empty: No meetups yet. Join a circle or host the first one!
home.locationDenied: Location is off, so we can't filter by distance.

meetup.title: Title
meetup.pinHint: Tap the map to drop the “find us here” pin.
meetup.signPlaceholder: e.g. yellow blanket next to the big tree
meetup.needPin: Drop a pin on the map first.
meetup.badTimes: The end must be after the start.

checkIn.too_early: Check-in opens 30 minutes before the start.
checkIn.too_late: Check-in has closed for this meetup.
checkIn.too_far: You seem to be more than 300 m from the pin.
checkIn.no_location: We need your location to check you in.

chat.closed: This meetup chat is closed. It's read-only now.
chat.reported: Thanks, the admins will take a look.
chat.title: Chat

board.title: Board
board.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Pin useful tips and links here.

people.title: People
people.search: Search by name, skill, field or language
people.waitingIntro: These people were invited by members. Vouch if you know them.
people.noCircles: Join a circle first to recommend people to it.
people.blocked: You blocked this person. You won't see their messages.
people.reportReason: Why are you reporting this person?
people.reported: Thanks, the admins will take a look.

me.title: Me
me.privacyText: Your profile is visible only to logged-in members. Your email is never shown. Data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt).
me.deleteConfirm1: Delete your account and everything you posted? This can't be undone.

invites.title: Invite someone
invites.intro: Third Place Berlin is invite-only. Your invite counts as your vouch, and one more member needs to vouch too.
invites.shareText: Join me at Third Place Berlin, our community app for people building a life in Berlin. Open this link on your phone:
invites.copied: Link copied. Paste it into WhatsApp.

notif.turnOn: 🔔 Turn on notifications on this phone
notif.on: Notifications are on for this phone.
notif.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your phone's settings.
notif.needsInstall: On iPhone, first add the app to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there.
notif.calm: By default you're never pinged for every message. That's what drowned the WhatsApp group.

admin.title: Admin
admin.notAllowed: Only admins can open this page.
admin.launchIntro: While open, anyone with this link joins directly as a member (founding members). Close it when the move from WhatsApp is done.
admin.launchText: 🎉 Third Place Berlin has its own app! Join with this link (founding members get in directly):

install.title: 📲 Install the app
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share (the square with an arrow) → “Add to Home Screen”, then open Third Place from your home screen.
install.android: On Android: tap the ⋮ menu → “Install app” (or “Add to Home screen”).
install.why: Installed, it opens full-screen and can send you notifications.
